rationale: To eliminate the -$11k cash deficit, this mutation implements a comprehensive margin and scale overhaul. It elevates Oracle Frontrun to Priority 3 to liquidate large commodity batches into pre-glut cyclical peaks (>=1.10x base) and raises routine liquidation floors to >=1.05x, reclaiming massive gross margin leakage. It safely scales land to 18-20 plots to fully monetize 10-11 hired hands, enforces strict shop seed phase-gates to prevent late-game stranded capital, purges phantom livestock feed reserves to accelerate early bootstrap, and formalizes fertilizer application in the farm execution sequence to maximize Strawberry compounding.
